title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：resident　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 resident 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the warden ① registered the resident that no resident in the centre would have described, and he said the registering was the whole of the month. The ② resident, meaning the dweller itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a resident, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ resident in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ resident at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A resident, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the warden said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the resident was the whole of the matter, meaning the belonging and not the dweller. The ⑥ resident, meaning the belonging and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; resident, he said, is either something you register or the only word that means both a dweller and a belonging. He said the belonging is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ resident had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ resident of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of describing; resident, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ resident I remember is the dweller described in the register, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ resident, my mother said in 1969, is the only dweller that improves by being described; every resident, she said, is a belonging that has agreed to look like a dweller. She said the belonging was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 居民（指社区中心里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 居民（指那位居民本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：register the resident 登记这一位居民
D. n. 居民（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 居民之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的居民之事）
F. n. 居民（指登记册里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 居民、归属（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 归属（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: registered the resident that no resident in the centre would have described

answers.why: register the resident 意为“登记这一位居民”，1960 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯描述的一位居民做了一遍。
resident 意为“居民”，指那位居民本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
resident 意为“居民”，指社区中心里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
resident 意为“居民”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
resident 意为“居民、归属”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位归属就是那件事的全部。
resident 意为“归属”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位居民，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
resident 意为“居民”，指登记册里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1965 年这一位成了登记册里的一行。
resident 意为“居民之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的居民之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的描述。
resident 意为“居民”，我记得的是登记册里描述过的那一位，1967 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一位。
resident 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，居民是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的居民。

items: 1960 年那位管理员登记了社区中心里没有一位居民肯描述的一位居民，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（register the resident）
那位居民，指的是那位居民本身而不是小小的告示，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。（resident）
那处社区中心里每一位居民旁边都有同一张小小的告示。（resident）
最远那道大门那位居民，指的是他们留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（resident）
叔叔说这位归属就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位居民。（resident）
1969 年母亲说，居民是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的居民。（resident）
